name: Wan Nyan Panic☆
source: The protagonist is alone for a week while her parents are on vacation and she's taking care of the family pets. Then a mysterious fairy leaves some magical pet food around, when the protagonist mistakenly feeds it to them the animals turn human! Now she has a week to solve this before her parents come home to a huge mess.
translation: 主角独自一人度过了一周，而她的父母正在度假，她正在照顾家里的宠物。然后一位神秘的仙女在周围留下了一些神奇的宠物食品，当主角错误地喂给他们时，动物们变成了人类！现在，她有一周的时间来解决这个问题，以免她的父母回家时陷入一团糟。
